structured.answer: A daily קרן כספית looks right for my 30K: about 3.25% a year compared with 0% in the עו"ש, and I can take the money out on any trading day. But the page never told me what it actually costs, so I'd ask my bank for the fee in shekels before I buy.

Walls of small dense text full of jargon (מק"מ, נאמן, ריאלי)
